source.title: Sum of Digit Differences of All Pairs

teaching.hint: Can you count contributions from one digit position without examining every pair?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: The pair difference is a sum of independent position indicators. Swap the pair and position summations, then count agreements using ten digit frequencies.
solution_outline.approach: For each decimal position, count its digit frequencies. Subtract the sum of within-digit pair counts from the total number of index pairs and add the remaining disagreeing pair count to the answer.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: At one position, every index pair belongs either to one equal-digit frequency group or to the complementary set of differing digits.
solution_outline.correctness: Exchanging two finite sums preserves the total. At a fixed position, digit groups partition agreeing pairs, with a group of f indices contributing f(f-1)/2. All pairs minus those counts gives exactly differing pairs there. Summing across every aligned digit position counts each pair contribution exactly as defined, including zero interior digits.
solution_outline.complexity: O(nd) time for d<=9 digit positions and O(1) auxiliary counters if each digit is extracted without consuming the input; 64-bit pair counts and total are required.
solution_outline.pitfall: Deduplicating equal-valued inputs removes distinct index pairs that the task includes.

common_wrong_turns: Deduplicating equal-valued inputs removes distinct index pairs that the task includes.
source_fidelity_notes: Made unordered distinct-index pair semantics explicit from examples; retained common digit width and real interior zeros.
